project.name: ORISO-Kubernetes
project.description: Kubernetes infrastructure and deployment orchestration repository for the ORISO platform.

nodes.name: cert-manager TLS
nodes.summary: Ingress TLS resources use cert-manager cluster issuer letsencrypt-prod.

nodes.name: Kubernetes service DNS
nodes.summary: Internal services use oriso-platform-* names under caritas.svc.cluster.local.

nodes.name: Sensitive values in ConfigMaps
nodes.summary: Some ConfigMaps render password-like values into non-Secret application.properties blocks.

nodes.name: Environment drift
nodes.summary: Values mix prod/local Spring profiles, dev domains, localhost local override, hostNetwork, and missing staging/prod overlays.

nodes.name: Externally exposed utility UIs
nodes.summary: Redis Commander, SigNoz, Storybook, Health Dashboard, and Status Page have public ingress definitions.

nodes.name: Local Helm dependencies
nodes.summary: The umbrella chart depends on local file:// subcharts and packaged chart archives.

nodes.name: Keycloak dev mode
nodes.summary: Keycloak starts with start-dev, hostNetwork true, default-style admin values, no probes, and no resources in chart values.

nodes.name: latest tags and pullPolicy Never
nodes.summary: Several application images use latest tags and pullPolicy Never, which couples deployments to node-local image state.

nodes.name: LoadBalancer plus Ingress exposure
nodes.summary: frontend, admin, and status-page values use LoadBalancer while separate ingress resources expose them too.

nodes.name: oriso-local namespace override
nodes.summary: values-local-macos.example.yaml switches local deployment to the oriso-local namespace.

nodes.name: local-path storage class
nodes.summary: Stateful charts use local-path storage, which is simple for k3s but weak for multi-node production recovery.

nodes.name: Manual ingress apply
nodes.summary: Ingress resources are not part of the umbrella chart and are applied separately with kubectl apply -f ingress/.

nodes.name: caritas namespace
nodes.summary: Most manifests and values deploy into the caritas namespace.

nodes.name: Nginx Ingress
nodes.summary: Ingress manifests assume nginx ingress class, regex rewrites, CORS annotations, and cert-manager TLS.

nodes.name: No CI/CD definitions
nodes.summary: The repository has no GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkinsfile, or similar pipeline definitions.

nodes.name: No autoscaling manifests
nodes.summary: No HorizontalPodAutoscaler manifests were found; most workloads default to one replica.

nodes.name: No NetworkPolicy manifests
nodes.summary: No NetworkPolicy manifests were found; service isolation depends on namespace/default cluster policy.

nodes.name: No PodDisruptionBudget manifests
nodes.summary: No PodDisruptionBudget manifests were found for stateful or critical workloads.

nodes.name: Observability stack
nodes.summary: SigNoz uses ClickHouse; OTEL Collector receives OTLP and forwards metrics; service-health-exporter polls backend health endpoints.

nodes.name: oriso-dev.site domains
nodes.summary: Dev/staging-like external domains route app, admin, API, auth, Matrix, LiveKit, SigNoz, Redis Commander, Status Page, and Storybook.

nodes.name: Ingress backends without charts
nodes.summary: UploadService and Rocket.Chat ingress/config references exist without matching Helm subcharts in this repo.

nodes.name: RollingUpdate strategy
nodes.summary: Most Deployment templates use RollingUpdate with 25 percent maxSurge and maxUnavailable.

nodes.name: Secrets rendered from values
nodes.summary: Several Secret templates and values files contain credential fields instead of referencing externally managed secret names.

nodes.name: service-health-exporter runtime install
nodes.summary: The health exporter installs Python packages at container startup and the script references an undefined exporter symbol.

nodes.name: kubectl last-applied annotations committed
nodes.summary: Several ingress files include kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration annotations with stale embedded service names.

nodes.name: Stateful storage
nodes.summary: MariaDB, ClickHouse, and SigNoz use StatefulSets/volumeClaimTemplates; MongoDB/Redis/Matrix mount existing PVCs.

layers.name: Platform Overview
layers.description: Repository boundary, top-level docs, namespace, domains, and orchestration model.

layers.name: Helm Charts
layers.description: Umbrella chart, subchart dependencies, values files, templates, and runtime service nodes.

layers.name: Ingress Routing
layers.description: External hosts, path rewrites, ingress resources, TLS, CORS, and backend routes.

layers.name: Service Communication
layers.description: Backend service DNS, infrastructure dependencies, auth, Matrix, RabbitMQ, MongoDB, and MariaDB relationships.

layers.name: Storage
layers.description: StatefulSets, PVC-backed services, local-path usage, and stateful dependencies.

layers.name: Observability
layers.description: SigNoz, ClickHouse, OTEL Collector, Redis Exporter, Service Health Exporter, status and health dashboards.

layers.name: Environments and Rollout
layers.description: Global values, local override, Helm install/upgrade flow, manual ingress apply, static replicas, and missing CI/CD manifests.

layers.name: Operational Risks
layers.description: Security issues, missing resource/probe/autoscaling controls, orphan routes, duplicated ingress config, and environment drift.

tour.title: Start at the deployment boundary
tour.description: README.md explains that this repository owns Kubernetes deployment configuration for ORISO, with Helm charts under helm/ and standalone ingress manifests under ingress/.

tour.title: Understand the umbrella chart
tour.description: helm/oriso-platform/Chart.yaml declares the local subcharts and helm/oriso-platform/values.yaml controls which platform services are enabled.

tour.title: Trace backend service wiring
tour.description: TenantService, UserService, AgencyService, and ConsultingTypeService connect through Kubernetes DNS to MariaDB, MongoDB, Keycloak, Matrix, RabbitMQ, and each other.

tour.title: Trace ingress traffic
tour.description: External traffic enters through nginx ingress and cert-manager TLS, then path rewrites route API prefixes and subdomains to ClusterIP services.

tour.title: Review state and observability
tour.description: Stateful storage backs MariaDB, ClickHouse, SigNoz, MongoDB, Redis, and Matrix; observability flows through service-health-exporter, OTEL Collector, SigNoz, and ClickHouse.

tour.title: Check rollout and environments
tour.description: Helm install/upgrade deploys the platform, ingress is applied separately, local macOS values use oriso-local and localhost domains, and no CI/CD pipeline definitions were found.

tour.title: Review the risk map
tour.description: The highest-value findings are hardcoded/values-rendered secrets, Keycloak dev mode, no HPA/NetworkPolicy/PDB, orphan ingress backends, latest/Never images, local-path storage, and exposed utility UIs.
